chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Shu'ayb, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (AS), from Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) who said:
Wear the cotton garments, for it is the clothing of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and our clothing; and he did not use to wear wool or hair except out of necessity.

key_terms.الشَّعْر: Hair/animal hair (goat hair or camel hair) — similarly discouraged without cause
key_terms.الصُّوف: Wool — worn by ascetics; permissible only for a reason
key_terms.الْقُطْن: Cotton — recommended as the preferred fabric for clothing in Shia jurisprudence
key_terms.عِلَّة: Necessity/ailment — the only permitted exception for wearing non-cotton materials
key_terms.لِبَاس: Clothing/garment — used here to emphasize the prophetic and imamic practice

ai.seo_question: What type of clothing does Islam recommend according to Imam Ali and the Prophet?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS), as transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS), instructed the believers to wear cotton garments, affirming that this was the practice of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) and the Imams themselves. The hadith also specifies that the Prophet did not wear wool or goat hair (coarser, ascetic materials) except when medically or physically necessary, establishing a practical sunnah of clean, comfortable dress as opposed to ostentatious asceticism.
